sentences.text: Susan Margaret Collins -LRB- born December 7 , 1952 -RRB- is a U.S. politician who currently serves as the senior United States Senator from Maine .	Maine	Maine	senior	Seniority in the United States Senate	United States Senator	United States Senator

A member of the Republican Party , Collins has served in the Senate since 1997 , and has served as the Chairwoman of the Senate Special Committee on Aging since 2015 and previously chaired the Senate Committee on Homeland Security from 2003 to 2007 .	Republican	Republican Party (United States)	Republican Party	Republican Party (United States)	Senate Special Committee on Aging	United States Senate Special Committee on Aging	Senate Committee on Homeland Security	United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
She is considered one of the most moderate Republicans in office .
She also is known for her long consecutive voting streak , which reached 6,000 votes in September 2015 .
She is the current dean of Maine 's congressional delegation .	Maine	Maine
Born in Caribou , Maine , Collins is a graduate of St. Lawrence University .	Maine	Maine	Caribou	Caribou, Maine	St. Lawrence University	St. Lawrence University

Beginning her career as a staff assistant for Senator William Cohen in 1975 , Collins later became the staff director of the Oversight of Government Management Subcommittee of the Senate Committee on Homeland Security in 1981 .	Senate Committee on Homeland Security	United States Senate Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs	William Cohen	William Cohen	Oversight of Government Management Subcommittee	United States Senate Homeland Security Subcommittee on the Efficiency and Effectiveness of Federal Programs and the Federal Workforce
She was then appointed as the Commissioner of the Maine Department of Professional and Financial Regulation by Governor John R. McKernan , Jr. in 1987 .	Maine	Maine	Governor	Governor of Maine

In 1992 she was appointed by President George H. W. Bush as the director of the Small Business Administration 's regional office in Boston .	George H. W. Bush	George H. W. Bush	Small Business Administration	Small Business Administration	Boston	Boston
Staying in Massachusetts , Collins became that state 's Deputy State Treasurer in 1993 .	Deputy State Treasurer	Treasurer and Receiver-General of Massachusetts

After moving back to Maine in 1994 , Collins became the Republican nominee for Governor in the 1994 general election .	Maine	Maine	Republican	Republican Party (United States)	Governor	Governor of Maine	1994 general election	Maine gubernatorial election, 1994
Becoming the first woman to become the nominee of a major party for Governor of Maine , Collins finished third in a four way race with 23 % of the vote .	Maine	Maine	Governor	Governor of Maine
After her bid for Governor in 1994 , Collins became the founding director of the Center for Family Business at Husson University .	Governor	Governor of Maine	Husson University	Husson University
Collins was first elected to the Senate in 1996 .	1996	United States Senate election in Maine, 1996

She has been re-elected three times , in 2002 , 2008 , and 2014 .	2002	United States Senate election in Maine, 2002	2008	United States Senate election in Maine, 2008	2014	United States Senate election in Maine, 2014

After former Senator Kelly Ayotte lost reelection in 2016 , Collins became the only Republican in the US Senate currently representing a state in New England .	Republican	Republican Party (United States)	Kelly Ayotte	Kelly Ayotte	New England	New England
